_comment: Ingest daemon parameters. Milestone 3: every write is one short BEGIN IMMEDIATE transaction with retries (fart/db.py).

pumpportal._comment: trade subscriptions are sent only when PUMPPORTAL_API_KEY is set (funded key); the subscription cap lives in config/engine.json -> watchlist.cap

rpc_logs._comment: creates (mint authority) and graduations (migration account); one connection

backfill._comment: sweep: getSignaturesForAddress on the mint authority and the migration account every sweep_interval_s. enrich (getTransaction of missed creates/migrations): migrations first, then creates, oldest first; max_cu_fraction_per_day x the daily CU cap / the getTransaction cost is the daily transaction limit (max_transactions_per_day is the fallback without a CU cap, i.e. on the public RPC). The daily report shows used/limit/skipped.

rpc_trades._comment: per-mint logsSubscribe over the keyed RPC websocket, BEFORE graduation only (reasons): the bonding curve PDA (mention 'bonding_curve') or the mint ('mint'). No pool subscriptions after graduation (one hot pool cost 79,604 notifications in 2 h on 26 Oct 2026); graduated coins are measured by the 5-minute DexScreener sampling of the tracker. max_notifications_per_subscription_per_hour: above it the subscription is dropped for the rest of its hour and counted. hourly_cu_fraction: the stream's own CU per UTC hour (ledger methods ws_trade_*) may not exceed this fraction of the daily cap (1/24 by default); above it every subscription is dropped until the next hour.
